evidence.excerpt: The project addresses a gap in predictive capability for residual stresses and warpage in injection-moulded semi-crystalline thermoplastics. The core activities include calibration of crystallisation kinetics models for PA6 and PP at industrially relevant cooling rates, implementation of a fully coupled thermomechanical simulation chain, and systematic experimental validation using in-mould sensors and post-ejection CMM and structured-light scanning. The project team of four researchers from the Faculty of Technical Sciences collaborates with the Faculty of Technology Novi Sad for DSC characterisation and with partners at the University of Maribor for material modelling. By the end of the project, a validated simulation workflow and a material parameter database will be made available as open data for Serbian polymer processing industry users.
